description: Water levels during a flood (since 2017) is a dataset listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Government and Municipalities of Québec | Gouvernement et municipalités du Québec. The Department of Homeland Security (MSI) supports the development of flood risk knowledge. In collaboration with Laval University and the Reunification of Quebec Basin Organizations, the MSI has developed a methodical and rigorous process for documenting floods that have an impact on the safety of people and essential goods. Coverage: Government and Municipalities of Québec | Gouvernement et municipalités du Québec. The portal files it under the publisher Government and Municipalities of Québec | Gouvernement et municipalités du Québec. Its tags are Crue, Decrue, Abandoned by the flood, Water, Level. It offers 7 resource(s) in CSV, GEOJSON, HTML, SHP, WFS. The portal shows 2026-09-23 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons 4.0 Attribution (CC-BY) licence – Quebec. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-canada-portal.
